annotations.title: Check an x402 payment before paying (free)

description: Free. Use right before paying an x402 seller: screens the payTo wallet against the OFAC list, looks up the seller's payer history, age and uptime from the Bazaar and Factline's nightly probes, and checks the amount against the seller's listed price and your budget. Returns allow, review or deny with reasons. Input: url of the resource, pay_to from its 402, optional amount_usd, max_usd, network.

amount_usd.description: Amount you are about to pay in USD, e.g. 0.05

max_usd.description: Your budget per call in USD

url.description: The x402 resource URL you are about to pay
